Hi Sam - thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and next steps so we're all aligned: 

Recap:
- Novacorp use case: customer support routing + embeddings for search. Production SLO: 99.9% latency < 150ms for 99th pct.
- Key decision criteria: security posture (SOC 2 + pen test), data retention controls, and procurement timeline/PO requirements.

As discussed, action items and owners: 
1) Please confirm the economic buyer and procurement contact for vendor onboarding (Sam) - you mentioned Priya might be procurement.
2) We will provide SOC 2 report, pen test summary, sample audit logs, and a short note on our data retention policy (Ben + Neha).
3) Legal/contract questions to Rachel for redlines and any standard vendor language (Rachel).
4) Proposed timeline: evidence delivered by EOD Friday (6/12), procurement questionnaire/PO by end of next week (6/19).

Attachments will be sent in a follow-up email (SOC 2 + pen test summary). Can you confirm the preferred secure upload method (SFTP/Drive/DocuSign link) and the names/emails of procurement and the economic buyer?

Thanks - I'll loop Marissa on success criteria and post-sale onboarding once we have procurement cadence.

Best,
Ben Carter

ben.carter@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Hi Sam/Priya/Aisha - thanks for reviewing the artifacts. A few clarifications and proposed timeline from our security team: 

Evidence checklist (what we provided and what's available):
- SOC 2 Type II (2025) - provided (attached).
- Pen test executive summary (2025) - provided. Full report can be shared under NDA with our security team.
- Audit logs: sample provided. We can generate custom CSVs with additional fields (request: list of required fields).
- Data retention: policy doc provided; retention-by-customer config is available and we can provide deletion workflows and timelines.
- KMS/HSM details, access controls, and IDS alerts - available for redacted review under NDA.

Proposed next steps and timeline: 
- Today (6/15): confirm whether Novacorp wants the full pen test report and/or auditor contact (NDA).
- By 6/18: provide any additional sample logs and a short note on retention-by-customer configuration.
- By 6/22: if procurement/legal require, set up a 30-min call between Novacorp security and Redwood security (Neha + Neha) to walk through controls and any SIEM integration questions.

If you can reply with the fields you need in the logs (eg: event_time, route, request_id, outcome, user_id (hashed)), we'll start generating a tailored sample. Also confirm preferred method for delivering full reports (secure Drive link or sftp).

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Sr. Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
